QUICK LEARNING MAP

Small rules. Big progress.

⏳
Past tense: did + base verbSay: “I didn't go,” not “I didn't went.”
🧱
Build a clear sentenceSubject + verb + object: “I finished the report.”
🔁
Present perfect“I have finished the report.” Use it when the result matters now.
🧭
Useful word partnersDiscuss the issue · focus on results · explain it to me.
❓
Ask questions“Did you finish?” not “Did you finished?”
🧩
Fix your weak spotsWrong answers are saved so you can review them.

🗺️ THREE-YEAR CURRICULUM ROADMAP

36 months. One skill at a time.

This is the planned progression for the programme. The current built-in exercise bank is smaller and repeats; the roadmap is not a claim that all 36 months of unique lessons are already loaded.

🌱
Year 1 · Build your foundationGrammar, sentence structure, daily-life vocabulary, conversation and basic workplace English.
🚀
Year 2 · Communicate professionallyMeetings, presentations, storytelling, explaining data, handling questions and more natural expression.
🏆
Year 3 · Refine and performNuance, persuasion, difficult discussions, spontaneous speaking, advanced revision and simulations.
Extra practice is always available. There is no 30-day lock or daily exercise limit; you can keep practising after completing a daily goal. Existing questions may repeat until additional content packs are added.
